candidate_windows.window_text: We used a single A100gpu to train the models. LoRA with a rank of 8 and alpha value of 16 was used for the finetuning. Deepspeed zero optimizer was used for better memory management. All the models were trained with 3 epochs. We used the AdamW optimizer with a learning rate of 2e-5 and a cosine learning rate scheduler. The weight decay of the models was set at 0.01 and a batch size of 4 was used. The initial finetuning was done with a 80-20 ratio of train and validation test while the entire artificial test set generated for positive-negative reward training was used for the training purpose.
